◈ FLASHBACK — Aisha's Drawing
Kitchen table, burnt pancakes. You told her the sun needed holding, and she took you literally — drew you carrying it with both hands. She was six. The sky changed three weeks later.
"Your understanding is... deepening! We can see it! Like watching a seed decide to be a tree! Beautiful! Profitable!"
The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Fernando speaks at Emberhold's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.

The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Fernando speaks at Ashford's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
Three fires bow to Haven. But a realm isn't leverage — it's seasons. These bonds are young; tend them, keep the trust, and the court will come.
💔 A faction of Stonebridge has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table is a new fire in the world now — 2 people under Kira.
📓 Codex: Stonebridge split (cannibal). The Red Table formed; 2 petition at Haven's fire.
Word later: they walked to The Red Table. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.

✨ Ability gained: Fusion Reactor (L1). The System installs your fusion pellet — properly, inside you. You never need to eat again: the pellet covers your metabolism, and your strikes and abilities burn with a steady reactor fire (1.25x, always on). One reactor per world, and it never comes out: not unslotted, not un-taught, not surrendered. Death is the only uninstall. But the hunger is gone, and
🧳 A traveler passed through yesterday, talking about a village to the southeast called The Red Table. The region is bigger than your fire.
🧳 Word comes late, through traders: The Hungry Road and The Red Table have bound together — The Hungry Road primary. Other fires are climbing, too.
📓 Codex: The Hungry Road and The Red Table bound; The Hungry Road primary.
◈ WORD TRAVELS — riders from The Red Table bring talk of Haven. Out there they call you the Feared. The show's narration lingers on your hands.
🥣 Tomás of The Red Table walks into your firelight alone, thinner than you remember. "Our jars are empty," they say. No preamble. "I'm asking for food."
Tomás waits two days at your fire, getting thinner. Nobody answers. They walk back to The Red Table with nothing. They'll remember the silence.
A runner from The Red Table, dusty and direct: "Your foragers are stripping our side of the southeast ground. Back off — or we'll talk with teeth." (Trust -3. The commons cuts both ways.)

◈ SYSTEM: "Four fires. One head. GOVERNANCE LAYER: online — polity tribute routing, the court calendar, famine reserves. You built a realm. Try not to lose it the way you found it."
📓 Codex: National beat staged: lead (4 villages).
Tomás waits two days at your fire, getting thinner. Nobody answers. They walk back to The Red Table with nothing. They'll remember the silence.
🍲 The shared granary opens: 5,000 kcal for every fire of the realm, no strings. Emberhold, Thornfield, Ashford count it — and remember who fed them first. (Trust +10 with each.)
◈ SYSTEM: "Oh. OH. Do you feel that? That's the whole PLANET leaning in. ...There's a table, little fires. A big one. Far away. And it is LOOKING at you. Give it a season worth judging."
📓 Codex: you've heard of **Harvest Table**. Someone, somewhere, can do this. Now you know its name.
◈ THE SYSTEM has been watching Milagros — Combat 1. Three offers; they took Harvest Table. Earned, chosen. (harvest_table: villager level-up)
📓 Codex: Milagros chose Harvest Table (harvest_table) at Combat 1.

◈ THE TABLE — the ring of pale light flickers at the edge of the sky... and does not come. The System does not apologize this time. "WE PRICED THE RUN. NO HUNGER ON THE RECORD — THE PELLET HUMS WHERE THE FIRE SHOULD BE. NO FEAST, NO SURGE, NOTHING HERE WE CAN PRICE. A COLD SPOT AT EVERY TABLE: THE WORDS WERE ON THE WRAPPER." You caught the lie in his face and watched the whole table react to it before he'd finished the sentence. Face and room, both open books.
🌙 Night. Shouts from the treeline — Kira of The Red Table with 3 others, and they're not here to talk. "Your pantry or your blood. Choose." (They want ~2,000 kcal.)
🌙 You weren't at the treeline. Kira of The Red Table didn't wait — they hit the stores and melted back into the dark with 803 kcal. The village will talk about this for a long time.

🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. Big Loud is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)
The table is being set — a lesser seat, priced for what you built. They are watching to see who comes to it.

◈ THE TABLE — it is not a table. It's a ring of pale light, and around it, things with too many angles to be faces. Above it all — the audience. Trillions of eyes, and every one of them knows your name. The System speaks, and for once it isn't performing: "HUMANITY PRESENTS ITS CASE."

◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — national standing, waves 1–3 faced (13/11/6), 12 contests survived, 3 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices.
◈ ABILITY — War-table: You read the table's fear the way you read weather. The Nielsen flinches first — you saw it.
◈ THE FEARED — "Look what eating built." The footage plays unasked — the deer, the fire, the ones who came for you and didn't come back. Nobody at the table is comfortable. That is the point.
The table has read your ledger. The food truth was shared. The light road is open.
The deer. The cleanest kill. The table goes very still. Behind you, your own people go still too — a different stillness.
You let them see it. All of it. The table recalculates. The fire back home burns a little lower.
You spend it — the shield, not the sword. The small envoy stares. Your people stand a little straighter. Protective terror: the table writes it down and doesn't understand it, which is the point.

The most frightening thing you ever did. The table doesn't know what to do with mercy from a predator. Neither do you, quite. But the audience weeps, and the galaxy learns that the feared one chose gentleness — and that choice echoes longer than any threat. The terror stays, pledged now: a shield over every village, forever.
You won. Say it plainly: you won. The village endures. The table signed. The galaxy applauds, and the applause is real, and you earned it.
